verdict.rationale: Termius documents its own SFTP file manager: a dual-pane desktop view for local and remote files, and one-click switching between a terminal and an SFTP session for the same saved host, so SFTP can reuse configured hosts and Keychain items. However, there is no evidence of scp support, and no explicit statement that SFTP sessions authenticate with Keychain keys. Missing for 10: scp transfer support, explicit documentation that SFTP uses the configured SSH keys, hands-on or independent corroboration of file transfers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can transfer files to and from remote hosts via scp and sftp using my configured keys

citations.quote: Dual-pane interface on the desktop: manage local or remote files side-by-side
switch between a terminal session and an SFTP session for the same host with a single click
supports SSH, Mosh, Telnet, Serial, and SFTP
Items in the Keychain can be referenced by multiple Hosts and Groups without duplicating them.
